name: University of Oulu
summary: University in Oulu, northern Finland; four English bachelor's in computing, electronics, software and business, each a 3+2 path to a master's.

ib.text: An IB Diploma, from Finland or abroad, qualifies for certificate-based selection, so no SAT is needed. IB in English, English A, or English B at 5 proves your English.

dates.label: Final IB diploma due and deadline to confirm your place, 15:00

programmes.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Software, intelligent systems and secure digital solutions, with specialisations in AI, applied computing, embedded systems and cyber security; admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's.

needs.note: National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.
National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.

programmes.selectionNote: 14 of 33 places on certificates such as the IB (technology table, 86+ of 172.1 points); 19 on SAT (1250+, maths 670+).

programmes.name: Electronics and Communications Engineering
programmes.about: Maths, physics and signal processing with electronics design, computer engineering, programming, measurement and telecoms, then a master's specialisation such as radio engineering.

needs.note: National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.
National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.

programmes.selectionNote: 8 of 33 places on certificates such as the IB, ranked on the national technology table; 25 on SAT (1200+, maths 600+).

programmes.name: Software Engineering and Information Systems
programmes.about: Building AI and software products around users' needs: human-technology interaction, information systems, software and digital services, with a practical, work-oriented approach.

needs.note: National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.
National technology threshold: maths or the science must reach grade 4.

programmes.selectionNote: 8 of 33 places on certificates such as the IB, ranked on the national technology table; 25 on SAT (1050+, maths 570+).

programmes.name: International Business Management
programmes.about: International business managed in a Nordic style, with creativity and sustainability as drivers, mixing theory and practice in an international setting.
programmes.ib: IB route is the January joint application (10 places); the separate rolling admission (1 Oct 2026 to 25 Feb 2027, 20 places) is SAT/ACT only.

needs.note: National business threshold: grade 2 in any IB maths.

programmes.selectionNote: January: 10 of 13 places on certificates such as the IB (business table, 75+ of 149.9 points), 3 via Talousguru. 20 more by SAT/ACT in rolling admission.

notes: Each programme admits to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's, and the three technology degrees take only 33 students each.
International Business Management has just 10 places in the January round, filled on certificates such as the IB; its other 20 go by SAT/ACT in rolling admission from 1 October 2026.
